trainers.instruction: Steve asks 5 of his colleagues about their favourite drink, and he constructs this pie chart. Are the following statements true or false?

atoms.a: 40% said that tea is their favourite drink.
20% said that juice is their favourite drink.
1 person said that coffee is their favourite drink.
50% said that coffee is their favourite drink.

trainers.instruction: Steve then asks more people around the office about their favourite drink. Colour in the pie chart accordingly.

atoms.a: 2 people said that juice is their favourite drink.
3/10 of people said that tea is their favourite drink.
50% said that coffee is their favourite drink.

trainers.instruction: Steve is comparing his two charts and wants to figure out some differences. Are the following statements true or false?

atoms.a: Fewer people picked tea in the first chart, than in the second chart.
The same percentage of people picked juice in the first chart and in the second chart.
Coffee was the most popular option in the second chart.
Fewer people picked coffee in the second chart than in the first chart.
